title: Controlled rebuild production approval gates
description: Single destination-free registry of the human approvals that are still required before production-impacting KIBER Portal actions. This file records boundaries only; it does not grant approval.

gates.title: Visual direction approval
allowedAutonomousWork: Prepare review screenshots and contact sheets
Run local visual QA and CI gates
Keep PRs open for explicit visual approval
forbiddenActionsUntilApproved: Treat screenshot approval as merge permission
Treat visual direction approval as production permission

gates.title: Final business/legal content approval
allowedAutonomousWork: Prepare approval packages without marking final approval

gates.title: Production media rights approval
allowedAutonomousWork: Collect source and alt metadata for review
forbiddenActionsUntilApproved: Replace preview gating with unrestricted production use

gates.title: Real public contact channels
forbiddenActionsUntilApproved: Publish real phone, email, messenger or requisites beyond approved legal documents

gates.title: Live lead routing destinations
allowedAutonomousWork: Validate static GET confirmation flow without delivery
forbiddenActionsUntilApproved: Enable CRM, Telegram bot, WhatsApp, email or webhook delivery
Store or transmit real lead submissions

gates.title: Analytics provider IDs and cookies
allowedAutonomousWork: Validate analytics attributes without provider IDs
forbiddenActionsUntilApproved: Configure Yandex Metrica, pixels or analytics provider IDs

gates.title: Production deploy, DNS and secret changes
allowedAutonomousWork: Run local builds and preview-only validation
forbiddenActionsUntilApproved: Modify shared Coolify, Traefik, Hermes or ai-class containers
